US farm counts on January 1, 1910–1949. Separate vertical scales; 1948 and 1949 figures were
preliminary. Source: USDA Statistical Bulletin 83 (1949), table 14, p. 45.
Capability, deployment, ownership and access are separate questions. A productive farm can
stand beside hunger.
Income and food access. In the 2024 survey, food insecurity was associated with income. These
two selected groups do not represent every income category, and the comparison does not
establish causation.
USDA ERS, ERR-358, Table 2
A working machine still needs an arrangement that lets people reach its output. Conceptual
illustration.
Fictional scene: pass the beans. The conversation turns from retraining to the floor people need
beneath them.
A possible pattern to notice in your own day. Conceptual illustration, not a diagnosis or a model
of brain chemistry.
One possible pattern of interrupted work. The drawing gives no fixed recovery time, interruption
threshold, or measured effect size.
A routine to try, observe and adjust. Two timed windows each day are an example schedule, not
a measured optimum.
Routines, not measurements of your brain. Some interruptions are useful or urgent. Try a
schedule and check whether it helps.
A day can feel cut into pieces. The ribbons illustrate interruptions, without measuring a cognitive
budget or a fixed recovery time.
A mesh can reroute only if a usable path remains. Crosses mark failed nodes; dashed links are
affected by that failure. People still maintain the circle and its connections.
Shorter supply lines can make repair and coordination more local. Imported parts, materials,
energy and human work remain; distance alone does not establish fair treatment.
Build regional capacity, then measure what it covers. Stores, seasonal production, water, power,
delivery and remaining imports determine how many people can be supplied and for how long.

its work. AI-adapted cutout
from
John Abella
CC BY 2.0
The energy in ammonia. IEA’s global-average estimate and best-available-process benchmarks
are different kinds of evidence. A benchmark is not proof every existing plant can achieve it.
IEA,
Ammonia Technology Roadmap, 2021
A gantry can reduce walking space in a bed. Tooling and behavior depend on the machine and
software version; this concept is not a build plan or a promise to automate the entire crop.
The greenhouse bus is a component map. Use moisture readings checked against the bed,
configure run-time and water limits, verify that water stops on faults and power loss, and retain
a manual shutoff.
One harvest, five doors. Eight kilograms from the garden and two from the food partner keep
the five-household promise. The buildings and route are illustrative; the vegetables supplement
meals.
One possible failure in recursive training on generated samples. This schematic is not a universal
outcome or a timetable; real data, sampling and training choices affect the result. Based on
Shumailov et al., Nature (2024).
Document useful work, tell the true story with consent, and keep the instructions available. A
platform may bring readers; a post is not guaranteed reach or income.
Capability still needs an
arrangement for access. AI-
adapted cutout from
Jonte
CC BY-SA 4.0
The model file is one layer of a working service. Running a useful service also takes software,
hardware, power, and people who maintain it. Conceptual illustration.
Memory before the overhead. These are derived weights-only sizes, not measured VRAM
requirements. They omit the chapter’s illustrative allowance as well as runtime costs.
llama.cpp,
memory and context options
Move heat out through a compatible, verified coolant loop. Heat rate uses mass flow in
kilograms per second: Q̇ = ṁ Cp ΔT. This diagram specifies neither components nor cooling
capacity.
What an acre costs. USDA survey estimates include farm buildings as well as land. These are
nominal national averages, not inflation-adjusted values or local offers.
USDA NASS, Land Values
2026, page 5
Useful ground comes with people and obligations. Shared use needs consent, clear terms, and a
way to challenge decisions. Conceptual illustration, not a legal template.
A shared-service network. People match usable surplus to requests and arrange delivery. The
drawing promises neither a yield nor an autonomous crew.
Two nominal forty-foot containers give a 640-square-foot exterior footprint. Usable space and
structural details depend on the finished design; the chapter’s budget is fictional.
Insulation is one layer in a wall. Air control, moisture, ventilation and fire protection have to
work with it.
One possible disruption sequence, not a clock. Existing stock, replacement routes, demand, and
the specific failure determine what reaches the shelves and when.
Where wasted food goes. EPA estimates for 2019 include inedible parts; the whole total could
not have been donated. Donation is net of food banks’ unusable portion.
EPA, Table 5
A mesh can route around a break only where another powered, usable path remains. Test the
missing relay.
A common land-trust housing arrangement separates ownership of land and home. Resale
terms need continuing stewardship; taxes and debt remain.
The soil food web cycles nutrients. Harvest and other losses remove them, so a productive bed
still needs measurement and appropriate replenishment.
The bed is part of a larger system. Plants, soil life, and returning organic matter exchange
nutrients; sunlight, water, replenishment, and the nutrients carried away in harvest still cross its
boundary. Conceptual cutaway, not a measured soil profile.
A hand-carried copy needs no live network link. It still needs trusted handling, a compatible
reader and a recoverable backup.
Tools with a history of use. AI-
adapted collage from
Shixart1985
CC BY 2.0
Growing an ingredient can reduce a bought input. It doesn’t establish a complete fish diet or a
closed system.
For a load that already uses DC, compare the whole path. Avoiding an inverter pair does not
remove charging, wiring or regulation losses.
A neighborhood fab lab combines suitable tools with trained people, supported materials and
checks for the actual job.
Shared tools need a working arrangement around them: trained people, suitable power and
materials, maintenance, and parts. The useful result leaves the bench. Illustrative workshop, not
a fabrication or wiring plan.
Ink for what is funded; pencil for the continuation still being proposed. The distinction matters
to the households expecting a delivery. Illustration of the fictional scene.
The proposal makes essentials a funded floor, available without a job. Tools help; remaining
work, supplies and reliable delivery still need provision.
When a meal fails. An illustrative worksheet from this chapter’s premortem record, not the
measured performance of a service. Confirm the alternative and the people who will deliver it
before expanding the promise.
Fictional scene: Rosa at the county hearing. A funded route means households can plan beyond
the next delivery.
Read from the bottom up. The first seven rungs draw on bounded precedents; the final two
describe how the proposal would be maintained.
Free to the person eating still leaves a working ledger: equipment, maintenance, remaining
labor, and delivery need dependable funding.
All twenty-four precedents. Square-ended dashed bars mark approximate periods; exact dates
and complete titles are in Appendix D.
Tier 0 ends with a test: can you open the reference and find what you need with the network off?
Record the source and date so you know which copy you have.
A year of practice, at a scale you can sustain. Shift the months to fit your season and your life; the
actions and precedent references follow below.
